programme.desc: Seishiro attends high school with Chitoge to protect her. As she's about to leave school, she suddenly comes under fire. Raku is dragged into Seishiro and Paula's feud. Can Raku escape safely?

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep10
programme.desc: Two years ago, Paradis welcomed their first visitor who was surprised to see one of their own. Obtaining their help will be critical in a three-part plan to protect Paradis.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep11
programme.desc: Trapped on the world's most dangerous island, Falco and Gabi will do anything to survive. Elsewhere, the public demands answers when they learn the savior of Paradis has been detained.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep12
programme.desc: While Hange and Pyxis piece together Zeke's true intentions, tension builds outside HQ where Armin and Mikasa plead for permission to speak with Eren.

programme.title: Attack on Titan Final Season Ep13
programme.desc: Gabi and Falco seek out a fellow Marleyan who's surprised to see Warrior candidates. The truth of what happened at Ragako may shed some light on Zeke's secret plans.

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep09
programme.desc: Zagan and Barbatos meets Raphael, the fearsome Holy Sword wielder, and learns about Chastille's punishment. Back at the castle, Barbatos arrives with Chastille, who has been poisoned.

programme.title: An Archdemon's Dilemma How to Love Your Elf Bride Ep10
programme.desc: Foll departs for the Archdemon Hall, seeking new power for her revenge. She confronts Raphael, who has been following her, and realizes the connection between him and her murdered father.

programme.title: Reborn as a Space Mercenary: I Woke up Piloting the Strongest Starship! Ep06
programme.desc: Takahiro 'Hiro' is reborn into his favourite game, commanding the best starship. He journeys across space as a mercenary to fulfil his dream of buying an expensive house with a garden.

programme.title: Full Clearing Another World Under a Goddess With Zero Believers Ep05
programme.desc: Makoto and his classmates are transported to another world, but he is the only weak one. Pairing up with a forgotten goddess, Noah, Makoto aims for the top using unorthodox methods, hardcore mode!

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep07
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: Magical Explorer Ep08
programme.desc: Reborn in a dating sim as a comic-relief side character with unexpected hidden powers, Kousuke, armed with extensive knowledge of the game, seeks a happy ending with the heroines he admires.

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: S2 Ep11
programme.desc: Chise learns that Lucy and Simeon are unconscious as a result of mana loss caused by 'The Testament of Carnamagos'. Chise accepts Elias' help to save the two of them, but...

programme.title: The Ancient Magus' Bride: S2 Ep12
programme.desc: On behalf of Lucy, Chise and friends visit the Waste Disposal Facility, where they encounter a suspicious man, Zaccheroni. Following his lead, they step into the basement of the facility...

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep11
programme.desc: Ichikawa's family is in Akita. While taking pictures of the scenery, Ichikawa falls and fractures his arm. Ichikawa informs Yamada of the incident and receives a video call from Yamada...

programme.title: The Dangers in My Heart Ep12
programme.desc: Ichikawa and family bump into Yamada at the shrine. Kana invites Yamada over to their house. Sensing the chemistry between her beloved younger brother and Yamada, Kana decides to play cupid.

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep01
programme.desc: Saito Hojo hates his classmate, Akane Sakuramori. Yet, the two are forced to get married by their grandparents. Thus begins the newlywed life of the two rivals under one roof...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep02
programme.desc: Saito and Akane's newlywed life is full of conflicts. Saito reaches out to Shisei, while Akane consults Himari. As they explore ways to live together more comfortably, they grow closer...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep03
programme.desc: Saito and Akane finally grow closer, but struggle to keep their marriage under wraps. Later, Akane pulls all-nighters studying for tests, but ends up catching a cold...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep04
programme.desc: Akane causes a ruckus after finding a ghost(?) at home. Saito asks Shisei for help as Shisei ends up staying over. Akane starts feeling uneasy over the closeness between Saito and Shisei...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep05
programme.desc: Himari tells Akane that she likes Saito and asks for her support. Himari and Saito get closer as Akane begin to have mixed feelings. Later, Himari visits Akane at home while Saito hides.

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep06
programme.desc: Himari suggests a group study session with Saito, Akane and Shisei, while Saito and Akane work hard to keep their secret. Later, Saito notices Akane feeling down and asks her on a date.

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep07
programme.desc: Saito asks his aunt, Reiko, for a part-time job in secret to buy Akane the ring she wants. Akane learns that Saito has been visiting Shisei's, but Reiko coldly brushes her off when she asks...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep08
programme.desc: Maho, a mysterious transfer student, confesses to Saito. She knows that he stays with Akane and asks him to show her around town. On their way back, Maho decides to follow Saito home...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep09
programme.desc: When visiting an amusement park, Saito learns that Maho used to be a sickly child. Despite his worry, Maho pretends to collapse, angering Saito. At night, Akane catches Maho in Saito's room...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep10
programme.desc: Saito and Akane's classmates learn about their secret. To stop rumors from spreading, Himari pretends to date Saito. However, the 'fake girlfriend' plan escalates beyond a pretense...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep11
programme.desc: Saito and Akane exchange contacts. Saito attends a family banquet while Akane and Himari bake sweets at home. Seeing Himari and Saito in close contact, just like lovers, Akane feels down...

programme.title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class Ep12
programme.desc: Akane recalls the first time she met Saito-the memory of a first love before they knew each other. After an incident, Himari makes a move on Saito and a photo of them spreads in class...

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep02
programme.desc: To track down the location of Magius base, Yachiyo hunts down Black Feathers. She encounters Kuroe and a small Kyubey. While chasing after Kuroe, Yachiyo bumps into Mifuyu Azusa.

programme.title: PUELLA MAGI MADOKA MAGICA SIDE STORY MAGIA RECORD 2nd SEASON -The Eve of Awakening- Ep03
programme.desc: Yachiyo and Kuroe find Iroha within the 'Perennial Cherry Tree' rumor, where they are devoured by the Doppel of silence. They awaken in a 'dream world', where Yachiyo tries to wake Iroha up.

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep09
programme.desc: The event with Galois turns out to be an act to test Sariphi's worthiness as queen. Sariphi gains the support of the ichthyosaureans, but Anubis refuses to accept it...

programme.title: Sacrificial Princess and the King of Beasts Ep10
programme.desc: On the day before a holy fete where the current king stands before his people donning the first king's mantle, a divine night triggers and Leonhart remains in his human form the next day.

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep03
programme.desc: Nene vows to get back at Arisu for seeing them undressed by catching him in an embarrassing situation. After school, they spot him entering a cafe, and they see him dressed as a waiter!?

programme.title: Tune in to the Midnight Heart Ep04
programme.desc: Shinobu Uzuki is swamped with work as the school's sports festival approaches. The club members worry she might be pushing herself. Seeing this, Arisu takes her to a quiet spot...

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep06
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: The Cold Sato-san Is Only Sweet to Me Ep07
programme.desc: Koharu Sato is known as the 'cold school beauty.' At his family's cafe, Sota discovers an unexpectedly endearing side to Sato. On top of that, it turns out the two have a mutual crush on each other!?

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: A hero (Chen Kuan Tai) battles assassins who use a deadly, beheading weapon to kill dissidents.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Jealousy threatens to expose the secret relationship of a 17-year-old student and her 35-year-old teacher husband.

programme.title: The Web of Death
programme.desc: A traitorous clansman bids to locate and then unleash the deadly 'Five Venom Spider' against those who bid to stand in his way.

programme.title: Double Bliss
programme.desc: Two ingenious lovebirds come up with what they think is a fool proof plan to get their parents to allow them to wed. Starring Ching Li.

programme.title: The Boxer From the Temple
programme.desc: A monk nicknamed 'The Kid' finds a barrage of gang fights on his hands after he meets a cruel bandit's son and an abused prostitute.

programme.title: The Enchanting Ghost
programme.desc: A cruel uncle stands in the way between a young scholar and the beautiful gal with whom he falls in love, and happiness.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: The Monk, Monkey, Friar Sand and Pig find themselves in a realm where women can only give birth to women unless loved by a man.

programme.title: Return of the Phoenix
programme.desc: In this masterpiece from Li Han Hsiang, sparks fly when minister Cheng Pu decides to marry off his youngest daughter before his eldest one.

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: In the wake of 'The Five Venoms', opera artists , Philip Kwok, Chiang Sheng and Lu Feng reunite with Lo Meng and Sun Chien in this politically charged thriller.

programme.title: A Friend From Inner Space
programme.desc: Sek Kin takes a refreshing break from his usual villain's role, playing a friendly ghost who befriends a young boy and helps him reunite his separated parents.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Ti Lung returns as Li Chin Huan, the renowned swordsman who must face the Chief of the Money Clan and his legion of assassins for the fate of the 'Martial Arts World'.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A young woman, who has gone through life disguised as a boy, must deal with her family's pressure for her to marry and the love of another woman.

programme.title: Princess Iron Fan
programme.desc: In this chapter of the 'Journey to the West' saga, the Monkey King and his gang are confronted by a whole host of fanciful villains.

programme.title: Scandal
programme.desc: When deadbeats Ming and Liang stumble upon records of scandals involving government officials, what follows is a humorous misadventure of epic proportions.

programme.title: Buddha's Palm
programme.desc: This new adaptation of the most powerful martial arts form is a cult classic for all fans. Witness breathtaking special effects.

programme.title: Long Road to Gallantry
programme.desc: Hui Ying-hung stars in this riveting swordswoman epic, as he embarks on a quest to find a missing martial arts manual.

programme.title: Twelve Deadly Coins
programme.desc: Flipping a coin' takes on a whole new meaning in this action-packed, martial arts melodrama - because the pocket change is actually deadly kung-fu weapons.

programme.title: Man of Iron
programme.desc: In this fight-filled sequel, Chen Kuan-tai's character wins a bet against a gang leader's son. Soon, father and son are hot on his heels!

programme.title: The Cave of Silken Web
programme.desc: Seven seductive Spiders lie in wait for our faithful heroes in the third installment of the Shaw Brothers adaptation of Journey to the West.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Linda Lin Dai plays a beauty tricked into sacrificing herself for the good of the Chinese people. However, the truth is revealed too late.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Alexander Fu Sheng stars in this movie as a man who is supposed to die from a cut by a sword with a teardrop forged onto its blade.

programme.title: The Crimson Palm
programme.desc: Featuring the unforgettable song Country Road, Shaw's Huangmei Opera stars Ivy Ling Po and tells the tale of a poor student engaged to a billionaire's daughter.

programme.title: The 36th Chamber of Shaolin
programme.desc: Winner of Best Martial Arts Award at the 1978 Asian Film Festival, this piece is directed by Liu Chia-liang and features his brother, Gordon, as a martial arts master.

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: Hsu Hsia, a great kung fu actor himself, both directs and leads a team of four martial arts choreographers in his hilarious tale of 'kung fu pickpockets.'

programme.title: The Magnificent Ruffians
programme.desc: In this gem from Chang Cheh, it's a battle between security agencies and five powerful fighters as they brawl until the last drop of blood is spilled.

programme.title: The Venus' Tear Diamond
programme.desc: Two master jewel thieves are set on the same target, but sparks fly between them when they first meet and they fall instantly in love, not knowing that they are rivals.

programme.title: The Duel of the Century
programme.desc: Two men find more than they bargained for when they attempt to investigate the apparent murder of a swordsman.

programme.title: Diau Charn
programme.desc: Set in the Han Dynasty, this drama depicts the legendary beauty Diao Chan, and how she used her charms to help her godfather eradicate corrupt court officials.

programme.title: Rape of the Sword
programme.desc: When a swordswoman falters in her attempt to reclaim her murdered husband's 'Green Sword', the world's sharpest blade, her protg continues her quest.

programme.title: Black Magic 2
programme.desc: In this mind-blowing sequel to the Shaw Brothers' horror hit, zombies run amok, driving doctors to seek a natural cause while the actual one may be supernatural.

programme.title: Diary of a Lady-killer
programme.desc: A man is arrested after every woman he had sexual trysts with ends up dead shortly afterwards but the murders continue.

programme.title: The Fake Ghost Catchers
programme.desc: This delightful action comedy featuring international favourite Alexander Fu Sheng presents a breathtaking showcase of wushu and wizardry.

programme.title: To Kill a Mastermind
programme.desc: Founded by rogue martial artists, the Qisha gang's specialty is crime. When spies infiltrate the group, they become caught in a power struggle between the gang leader and his righthand man.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll by
programme.desc: A doctor falls for a schizophrenic old classmate he's treating who refuses to accept that her lover is dead.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: In this award-winning Chang Cheh film, David Chiang plays a psychotic who stops at nothing to avenge his elder brother's death.

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: An alluring female fairy seeks love among mortals and finds it in a man who takes care of an orphanage.

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: When villains 'Winged Tiger' Teng Fei and 'Underworld King' Yin Te Lung unite, the martial arts world is plunged into chaos. Can this deadly duo be stopped?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: After Ah Niu moves to Hong Kong, a kind-hearted fellow from rural China is taken advantage by cunning characters including his uncle.

programme.title: The Five Venoms
programme.desc: The dying master of the powerful Poison Clan dispatches his last pupil, Yang Tieh, on a crucial mission to atone for the evil deeds of his clan disciples.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: In this action-packed thriller, director Lo Wei plays a fishing village bully, whose son lusts after a local beauty.

programme.title: The Swift Knight
programme.desc: Lo Lieh finds himself involved in romance, court intrigue and deadly jousts while trying to protect a baby who is the Emperor's secret heir apparent.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: In this martial arts epic, a gruesome family feud ensues due to a prince being favoured more than his brothers. Starring David Chiang.

programme.title: Shaolin Hand Lock
programme.desc: Directed by Ho Meng Hua, this film depicts the currents that buoy two families, sweeping them toward revenge in the wake of an unexpected reunion.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: Starring teenage heartthrob Pat Ting Hung, this film marks the directing debut of the kung-fu film genre's most respected figure, Chang Cheh.

programme.title: King Eagle
programme.desc: Ultimate combat is in the offing after King Eagle Chan Fei learns that Hung Ching Tien murdered their chief in a power struggle.

programme.title: The Yellow Muffler
programme.desc: This Inoue Umetsugu musical depicts the struggle of two singing sisters, Ching Ping and Pai Hung.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei Pei stars as Hsiao-Yun, a young singer struggling to juggle her career and her relationship with her pianist lover.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: A man (Alexander Fu Sheng) must learn several unique martial arts styles and compete in three trials before he can marry his beloved.

programme.title: Carry on Doctors and Nurses
programme.desc: Director Anthony Chan joins award-winning social satirist Alfred Cheung Kin Ting in this delightful variation on the hugely successful British Carry On!

programme.title: The Knight of Knights
programme.desc: In seeking to avenge his six comrades' murders, a swordsman must battle against Qiao Qing Monastery's notorious monks.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Director Lu Chun-ku leads Liu Yung, Liang Yun-hsin and 'Thundering Mantis,' Liang Chia-jen on a madcap quest filled with double crosses and triple plots.

programme.title: Village of Tigers
programme.desc: Shu Pei-pei shines in this production alongside hero Yueh Hua, her stalwart companion, in a battle to rid their town of killers and thieves.

programme.title: The Blue and the Black Part 2
programme.desc: This sequel captures how singer Tang Qi searches through battle-scarred China for her soldier lover, Xing Ya. However, are they fated to be apart?

programme.title: The Eight Diagram Pole Fighter
programme.desc: Martial arts greats Lau Kar Leung and Alexander Fu play out the vendetta of General Yang and the creation of the unique eight-diagram pole fight technique.

programme.title: Na Cha and the Seven Devils
programme.desc: Little Na Cha accidentally drops 7 magical peaches onto earth, which transformed 7 animals into devils. Na Cha must hunt them all down or his father will be punished by the King of Heaven.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: While returning the stolen Golden Sword to the palace, a sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master, only to return as a spirit to take revenge against the evildoer.

programme.title: Vengeance of a Snow Girl
programme.desc: Enjoy Lo Wei's very last Shaw Brothers film, the fabulous tale featuring Li Ching of a frostbitten swordswoman out to get her parents' murderers.

programme.title: Pursuit
programme.desc: Written and directed by Cheng Kang, this classic film starring Yueh Wah depicts how the Sung Dynasty army's chief instructor is framed by a corrupt minister.

programme.title: Forever and Ever
programme.desc: Huangmei Opera queen, Ivy Ling Po stars in this tale of a young scholar who is manipulated into marrying a nobleman's reluctant daughter a girl who is dying.

programme.title: Return of the Sentimental Swordsman
programme.desc: Ti Lung returns as Li Chin Huan, the renowned swordsman who must face the Chief of the Money Clan and his legion of assassins for the fate of the 'Martial Arts World'.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: The Monk, Monkey, Friar Sand and Pig find themselves in a realm where women can only give birth to women unless loved by a man.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Loyal to the emperor, the protagonist attempts to stop the delivery of a message depicted across twelve gold medallions that is to be delivered by traitors.

programme.title: Marco Polo
programme.desc: Directed by the legendary Chang Cheh, this rousing tale presents a fictional account of the famous Italian explorer's adventures.

programme.title: King Drummer

programme.title: The Shadow Whip
programme.desc: Various people are out to get the Shadow Whip (an individual, not just a weapon). Starring Cheng Pei Pei and Yueh Hua.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Wei Hung plays the Swordsman At Large, in this deceitful tale of bandits, beauties and blade masters who battle for glory.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: Veteran director Yen Chun excels in this tale of the Dragon Sword and the evil Security Agency, beautiful swordswomen and bandits who want it.

programme.title: Hex After Hex
programme.desc: In this comedy, hellish emotions are unleashed when a demon arranges to have his true love killed in order to possess her. Starring Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Proud Youth

programme.title: Love Without End

programme.title: The Chinese Boxer
programme.desc: A Chinese martial arts student (Wang Yu) trains hard to defeat the karate expert (Lo Lieh) who brutally killed his master and peers.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: A young couple lived happily in a house but the woman becomes haunted after she accidentally kills her husband.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince

programme.title: Buddha's Palm

programme.title: Madam White Snake

programme.title: The Flying Guillotine
programme.desc: A hero (Chen Kuan Tai) battles assassins who use a deadly, beheading weapon to kill dissidents.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl

programme.title: Guess Who Killed My Twelve Lovers?

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Serio-comic clashes of cultures ensue when a Mainland Chinese family try to make a go of it in Hong Kong.

programme.title: The Kung-fu Instructor

programme.title: Tales of Larceny

programme.title: What Price Honesty
